maddeler.e:
تسامرت (form VI)
# تَسَامَرْتُ (tasāmartu) /ta.saː.mar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَسَامَرَ (tasāmara)
# تَسَامَرْتَ (tasāmarta) /ta.saː.mar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَامَرَ (tasāmara)
# تَسَامَرْتِ (tasāmarti) /ta.saː.mar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَامَرَ (tasāmara)
# تَسَامَرَتْ (tasāmarat) /ta.saː.ma.rat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
